notes.title: DLC coming soon
notes.content:
Drums Hero is about to celebrate its first DLC, which includes 10 carefully selected songs, and I hope you enjoy it.

The songs we choose are very cool, and they all have one feature: a strong temperament. In addition, there are several pieces of Chinese, Mongolian songs in DLC, from the very young creators, I hope you love. 

New song’s drum spectrum refers to digital percussion pad, it will make your hands movements more regular, more fun to play. The basic rhythm beat with rich change fill, will make you more deeply appreciate the music, feel the music fun, experience performing pleasure. We have also made some adjustments to the difficulty of playing, and you will find that the overall difficulty is much lower and easier to play.

Finally, it is a special reminder that the player needs to leave the drum surface quickly after each stroke, so that the playing process is more accurate and regular.
	
27 club-THE MUFF
Retro rock from China

 Shot Of 69-The MUFF
A very sexy song

adam da r-Sintas Band
Modern rock with Kazakh people of Xinjiang, China
 
Anything But Everything-Color Out
Maybe the most exciting drumming experience
 
Matches-Slow Corpse
The rhythm is lively and funny
 
What Is Love-Melanie Ungar
Gentle love song
 
Lucky Day-RogerThat
The feeling of basking in the sun
 
Meanwhile-Roller Genoa
A lazy and powerful song
  
Tomorrow Wanted-Tomorrow Wanted
Chinese Dance meets Bruce rock
 
深海怪兽-Crow’s –Feet Band
Very cool Chinese Rock

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 patchnotes - July 10th
notes.content:
1.  Adjusted drum set model of the stage scene, so as to reduce the chance of accidentally touching.
2.  Reducing drum tone feedback delay
3.  Added the OFFSET settings (Below the auto-play switch)
     a)  This setting will move all notes forward / backward if you feel a song note 
     and background music not match
     b)  Adjustable range is -100ms to +100ms, each unit is 10ms
     c)  Each song can be set up separately, and the settings will be autosave.

notes.title: Version 1.2 update
notes.content:
[h1]  1. Introduction[/h1]
Hello, I'm FISH, we meet again. Please allow me represent our development members thanks to all the players. We've received a lot of feedback from players during this time, and we've watched each comment and discussed the feasibility of the practice. We're honored to be happy for so many players. We will continue to work hard and bring more fun to the players. Let's take a look at this update. 
[h1] 2. New songs[/h1]
		We finished our second album on time, and I hope you like them.
[h1] 3. New scenes and new model[/h1]
	a. We added a new stage scene, and added options for switching scenes at each song difficulty selection interface. The new scene is a gorgeous stage, and the surroundings change with the beat of the music. In front of the stage, there is a large screen that will slowly surround show the player's image. When players reach a certain number of combos, there will be a new combo effect. Of course, if you still like the classic scene, just switch it on the song interface. 
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/75d31e667c26229152acf8c877683d0abe59a37c.jpg[/img]
	b. In the new scene, the drum model has become more realistic. The new drum set is almost identical to the real drum kit. And you can also adjust its overall position. Cymbal and hi hat and ride has new feedback animation, you must try it anyway :)
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/02c5cf9ef3c94b9af9cdd016ab6251be490841e6.jpg[/img]
[h1] 4. Controller support[/h1]
	a. We used to have a bad interaction experience to be compatible with multiple patterns. Now we are going to separate the controller mode and become the Drums Hero PC version. 
			http://store.steampowered.com/app/644610/
			This is a shop link, but our VR users don't have to buy it again. Please contact me, I will give CD-KEY to our VR users in a week. 
		
	b. Now VR mode can now support the Xbox controller of the game, believe me, this experience is very good. 


Your devoted friend, Fish.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 patchnotes - May 23rd
notes.content:
[h1]New song Make Believe - VITNE - rock
Visual optimization of note determination
 Hit determination bug fixes
 Unlock interface add challenge button
Fixed the problem that HTC VIVE users cannot start game from desktop icons.
  [/h1]
	
	Since the steam widget does not support Oculus perfectly, we have contacted Steam technical support, but this problem is not completely resolved for the time being. Otherwise, the game will appear handle vibration bug and picture jitter problems.
	DrumsHero is limited by cost and manpower, and there are many imperfections. 
But we will always try to improve the game experience and make it a classic game like guitar hero (It might be a long time). The players will walk with us, We believe! :)

notes.title: version 1.1 significant update
notes.content:
[h1]Add 5 new songs
some easy mode are reworked
Combo will have new animation effects
UI interface is remaked
Visual optimization[/h1]
[code]  Dear players, Hi! My name is Fish. I am from Drums Hero's independent development team. I am in charge of the overall planning and design of our game. I wish we could be friends through this game.ːsteamhappyː：）
  We carefully check every feedback of each player since Drums Hero release date. We make the greatest efforts to analyze and solve the players’ problems in the game in order to give the players better experience. After a month of efforts, we launched the 1.1 version. We sincerely wish that players can communicate with us in the user community. We welcome each player participate in the game development process. Now let's take a look at the 1.1 version.[/code]

[b]In order to celebrate this significant update, we will launch the weeklong discount from 15th May. to 21st May. Hope you will like it! Thanks![/b]

[h1] New songs	[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]Angle-Golden Duck orchestra  rock
 [*]Feel-Fullcasual_dnb  electronic
 [*]Dreams-Manhat10   electronic
 [*]Let Me Go-STEEP  rock
 [*]Moons-Slow_Corpse  electronic
[/olist]
 [code]  We add at least one song every week until we finish the ten tracks of the second album. More songs’ copyright is in the contract process, we will continue to add more great music into the game.[/code]

[h1]Music adjustment:[/h1]
 [code]Easy mode renamed Fun Mode, the following songs’ easy mode were reworked. We think that interest is more important than difficulty upgrading. And we still retain the six easy mode music to ensure the new users could start smoothly [/code]

[olist]
Music of easy mode reworked as below,
 [*]Let It In
 [*]West Coast Highway
 [*]100 Days
 [*]Born Free
[/olist]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/63b236f9bdba91edc9920afea0c819a7a7852744.jpg[/img]

[h1] UI [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/971bfb9839d3198079cb951132a2ac537507b443.jpg[/img]

[list]
    [*]We use the UGUI remake the UI interface. We solve the UI text clarity problem. We use the album + song structure. Players can easily manage hundreds of songs. After that we will launch more different theme album to promote more high-quality original music.
[*]settings option temporarily not open, because we are currently considering the functions as below
1.background music volume adjustment
2.player percussion drum volume adjustment
3.Perfect judgment offset adjustment
4.scene and drums model replacement (it seems the news leaked out (*>. <*))

Do you have any better idea? We look forward to discussing this design with you.
[/list]
[h1]Interaction[/h1]
 [code] We found on the players in the game often accidentally press the pause button from the YouTube video. A player from Taiwan find that he can put the drum down to sit down to play after standing more than an hour. '(*> ﹏ <*)' ~
UI operation and interface should be compatible with the controller, htc vive, oculus and a variety of computer keyboard model. After repeated thinking, we decided to PC version and VR version completely separated. We decided to retain only the VR mode the current version , and the interactive way also changed to the traditional VR interactive mode. Of course, we did not give up non-VR users. We will released the Drums Hero PC version. And this version will be free for the VR users who purchase the game before the Drums Hero PC released.[/code]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/1bbf0e97b634edca93382909322cebfb18f14364.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Withdraw the PC mode only retains the VR mode.
 [*]We will soon release a separate version of the PC mode, which will be an unique game. 
 [*]UI interaction changes to VR ray mode. 
 [*]Pause button changing to the physical console in the game. You no longer have to worry about accidentally pause. * ^ _ ^ *
 [*]More intuitive drums position adjustment: hold the trigger when dragging the direction of the ball, you can adjust the drums position.
 [*]No matter how to move, the bass drum will be keep on the floor 
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/a486b0ff45f939b469863d1e6ef35e7e3ba566cf.jpg[/img]

[h1] Scene[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196482/02b711966055f0f2f214d033aa3663dbe31c9fda.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Increase the pre load of the scene, dramatically improve the scene frame rate, and more stability.
    [*]The new score panel, the future will support lyrics display. I think it's better to play and sing, but please be careful do not to disturb the neighbors.
    [*]Added new decorations.
    [*]Added turning roads and slopes.
    [*]Added a visual animation for the bass drum. Rhythm perception is stronger, although there is no foot action tracking, players can try to add their own action to play. Believe me, after a period of practice, you can show on the real drums. It's not only a game, but also you can use it as a learning tool for the drums. Maybe we will cooperate with the foot equipment to increase the learning mode of drums performance.
[/list]
[h1]Combo effects[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cancel some exorbitant performance trailing effects animation. Music game on the sensitivity of the frame rate more than other types of games. So we must ensure the stability of the picture. Based on that, we've added other combo effects. 
[*]Combo to reach 25, 50, 100, 150 will have the new animation effects. Keep the combo will make the scene more and more fascinating!
[/list]
[h1]Percussion feel optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*]	We add a few seconds preload before the game start of. The scene frame rate increased by 30% to 50%, and more stability.

[*]	Equipment tracking loss will cause the screen to be out of sync with the music. This problem occurs only in HTC VIVE hardware. We are still trying to solve the problem to ensure that when lost, music and picture synchronization. We recommend htc users connect two tracking positioning device before starting the game.

[*]We slow down the notation speed and background sound to match for every song. Most of the players are not professionals, so we set slightly wide scope of the note determine. Hit the drum in the determining line will be the most accurate.

[h1]At Last[/h1]
[code] I'm talking too much, the team guys don't want me to go on. In general, Drums Hero is a game that will continue to surprise the player, if you can see our progress list. ：）
  Let us work together to build a three-dimensional simulation of the best music game.

                                             POM Play Music
                                                       Your devoted friend, Fish.[/code]
